shots.visual: An emperor in dark regal robes holding a bamboo scroll under flickering candlelight, eyes narrowing with suspicion.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 劉備病重需靈芝？絕不可信！

shots.visual: The angry emperor slams his fist onto the bronze table, pointing sternly forward.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 傳令斥候，即刻摸清虛實！

shots.visual: A calm middle-aged warlord sitting behind a desk, swirling tea in a cup with a cold smirk.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 曹丕上鉤了，魏軍已派斥候。

shots.visual: A strategist in a feather robe fanning himself gently, eyes twinkling with sharp intelligence.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公神算，早已佈下口袋陣。

shots.visual: A dark forest valley illuminated by sudden torchlight as hidden soldiers burst forth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 深夜夷陵山谷，殺聲震天！

shots.visual: Armored soldiers tackling enemy spies to the muddy ground and binding them with ropes.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 一個不留，全都給我生擒！

shots.visual: A captured enemy scout kneeling in dirt, sweating in utter terror.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 魏軍精銳斥候，全軍覆沒。

shots.visual: The strategist standing proudly beside a row of massive brass loudspeakers facing distant city walls.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 架起大喇叭，向宛城喊話！

shots.visual: Soldiers shouting together into giant brass horns, sending booming sounds towards distant battlements.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 滾滾雷音，傳遍宛城城頭。

shots.visual: The emperor clutching his ears as deep reverberating shouts reach his inner chamber.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 外面在喊什麼？快閉嘴！

shots.visual: The strategist looking into the dark horizon with an expression of sharp ridicule.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 司馬畏縮不前，乃天下笑柄！

shots.visual: The furious emperor hurls a jade cup onto the stone floor, shattering it completely.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 司馬懿！你竟敢怯戰不前！

shots.visual: A rival ruler in purple robes pacing nervously across an ornate hall with a grim face.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備大勝？絕不能讓他稱霸！

shots.visual: The warlord sits alone inside his dimly lit tent, flickering oil lamps casting long shadows.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 勝了一局，真正的戰鬥剛開始。

shots.visual: The strategist on the left solemnly hands a ceramic bowl of dark steaming liquid to the warlord on the right.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，該服藥了。

shots.visual: Close-up on the black, ominous concoction reflecting the warlord's cold eyes.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這劇毒，又能壓制幾時？

shots.visual: The warlord tilts his head back, drinking the black liquid in one decisive gulp.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 黑藥入喉，如烈火撕裂內臟。

shots.visual: Veins pop on the warlord's neck from agony, but a terrifying smile spreads across his face.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 司馬仲達，以為我在裝病？

shots.visual: Over the worried strategist's shoulder, watching the warlord wipe a streak of dark fluid from his lips.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，您身體承受不住了！

shots.visual: The warlord gazes forward with a vicious, murderous gleam in his dark eyes.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 毒發前最後的清醒，送你一程！

shots.visual: Extreme close-up on the warlord's eye reflecting a blood-red light flick, freezing on intense resolve.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 瘋狂的豪賭，序幕拉開！
